title: The pack's behaviors/scenario-bindings.json
description: Every scenario in the pack, and where the target system can observe what it asserts. A projection: c9 merges each behavior's c7b output, sorted by behavior id then scenario id, and adds nothing. Kept out of the BHV-####.md documents deliberately — those describe the legacy application, while a binding is a target-side fact derived from the API contract and invalidated when api-conventions.yaml changes. One fact, one place.

conventions_hash.description: The api-conventions.yaml every binding was decided against. Must equal the hash in manifest.json — bindings derived against different conventions than the shipped API contract describe a system the pack does not specify.

operation_id.description: Present when surface is 'rest'; resolves within api/openapi.yaml.

open_question_id.description: Set by c9 for every binding with surface 'not-observable' or preserves_legacy_meaning false, pointing at the open-questions entry it seeded. This is the link that makes an adapted assertion findable from both directions.
